news.title: Mendoza Reimagines the Master of Science in Management for the Next Generation of Business Leaders
news.summary_en: The program redesign adds three career-focused concentrations, expands eligibility to business majors and incorporates the residential Master of Nonprofit Administration.

news.title: Longtime Business Librarian Pete Pietraszewski Takes a New Role
news.summary_en: Under Pete Pietraszewski's leadership the business library became a place where expertise and collaboration helped people do their best work.
